```{r}
# --- Standardize predictors ---

X_train_sd <- sapply(X_train, sd, na.rm = TRUE)

df_train_scaled = cbind(X_train_scaled, Real = y_train, SampleID = train_samples)
df_val_scaled = cbind(X_val_scaled, SampleID = val_samples)

# then cbind the original df_val with identifier columns
df_val_scaled = cbind(df_val_scaled, df_val[, c("POS", "REF", "ALT", "AF")])
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
# --- Train-test split (stratified) ---
set.seed(42)
train_idx <- createDataPartition(y, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
# Save indices for reproducibility
save(train_idx, file = "train_idx.RData")

# Load if needed later
# load("train_idx.RData")

X_train <- X[train_idx, ]
y_train <- y[train_idx]
X_val <- X[-train_idx, ]
y_val <- y[-train_idx]

train_samples <- samples[train_idx]
val_samples <- samples[-train_idx]

# --- Standardize predictors ---
X_train_mean <- sapply(X_train, mean, na.rm = TRUE)
X_train_sd   <- sapply(X_train, sd, na.rm = TRUE)

# Save mean and SD for later scaling of validation or test data
save(X_train_mean, file = "X_train_mean.RData")
save(X_train_sd, file = "X_train_sd.RData")

# Scale training predictors
X_train_scaled <- as.data.frame(scale(X_train, center = X_train_mean, scale = X_train_sd))

# You can later apply the same scaling to validation:
X_val_scaled <- as.data.frame(scale(X_val, center = X_train_mean, scale = X_train_sd))

# combine into dataframes
df_train_scaled = cbind(X_train_scaled, Real = y_train, SampleID = train_samples)
df_val_scaled = cbind(X_val_scaled, Real = y_val, SampleID = val_samples)
```

```{r}
compute_metrics <- function(df, pred_col = "predicted", true_col = "Real", threshold = 0.5) {
  # Binarize predictions based on threshold
  df$pred_class <- ifelse(df[pred_col] >= threshold, 1, 0)
  
  # True positives, false positives, true negatives, false negatives
  TP <- sum(df$pred_class == 1 & df[true_col] == 1)
  FP <- sum(df$pred_class == 1 & df[true_col] == 0)
  TN <- sum(df$pred_class == 0 & df[true_col] == 0)
  FN <- sum(df$pred_class == 0 & df[true_col] == 1)
  
  # Metrics
  precision <- if ((TP + FP) == 0) NA else TP / (TP + FP)
  recall <- if ((TP + FN) == 0) NA else TP / (TP + FN)  # Sensitivity
  specificity <- if ((TN + FP) == 0) NA else TN / (TN + FP)
  
  # Return as a list
  return(list(
    precision = precision,
    recall = recall,
    specificity = specificity,
    sum_sens_spec = recall + specificity
  ))
}

# Function to find best threshold
compute_best_binarization_threshold <- function(df, pred_col = "predicted", true_col = "Real", thresholds = seq(0, 1, 0.01)) {
  metrics <- sapply(thresholds, function(t) compute_metrics(df, pred_col, true_col, t))
  metrics_df <- as.data.frame(t(metrics))
  metrics_df$threshold <- thresholds
  
  best_row <- metrics_df[which.max(metrics_df$sum_sens_spec), ]
  best_thresh <- best_row$threshold
  
  return(best_thresh)
  # return(list(best_threshold = best_thresh, metrics = metrics_df))
}
```

```{r}
# Fit a mixed-effects logistic regression model
model <- glmer(
  Real ~ COV_RATIO + CLIPPED_BASES_RATIO + DISCORDANT_READS_RATIO + Mean_BQ_ALT_allele + (1 | SampleID),
  data = df_train_scaled,
  family = binomial(link = "logit")
)

# save the fitted model
save(model, file = "/home/sak0914/MtbLongitudinalDiversity/lowAF_variant_calling/variantDetector/model_1/linear_mixed_model.RData")

# get predictions on the training set
df_train_scaled$predicted <- predict(model, type = "response")

# plot ROC AUC
train_roc_obj <- roc(df_train_scaled$Real, df_train_scaled$predicted)
plot(train_roc_obj)
auc(train_roc_obj)

# maximize the sum of sensitivity and specificity
best_threshold <- compute_best_binarization_threshold(df_train_scaled)
print(paste("Best threshold", best_threshold))
```

```{r}
# get predictions on the training set. re.form = NA ignores random effects. Needed if you have some samples in the validation data not in the training data
df_val_scaled$predicted <- predict(model, newdata = df_val_scaled, re.form = NA, type = "response")

# add the binary predictions, binarized at the best_threshold
df_val_scaled$pred_class <- ifelse(df_val_scaled$predicted >= best_threshold, 1, 0)

# save
write.csv(df_val_scaled, "/home/sak0914/MtbLongitudinalDiversity/lowAF_variant_calling/variantDetector/model_1/linear_mixed_model_predictions.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
